achievements.label: First Contract
achievements.description: Complete your first sale.

achievements.label: Hands Off
achievements.description: Automate a ship for the first time.

achievements.label: Full Fleet Autopilot
achievements.description: Fill every automation slot you've unlocked.

achievements.label: Whatever's Most Urgent
achievements.description: Switch Fleet Priority on for the first time.

achievements.label: Reassigned
achievements.description: Have an idle automated ship reposition itself under Fleet Priority for the first time.

achievements.label: Fast Ships I
achievements.description: Research the Fast Ships I upgrade.

achievements.label: Bigger Holds
achievements.description: Research the Hauler-Class Refit.

achievements.label: More Hands
achievements.description: Research the Automation Expansion.

achievements.label: Fully Studied
achievements.description: Unlock every shared research node and finish one specialization path (Automation or Market).

achievements.label: New Frontier
achievements.description: Unlock the Galaxy Expansion and reach the Kepler Cluster.

achievements.label: Growing Pains
achievements.description: Develop any colony to Level 2 for the first time.

achievements.label: Established Economy
achievements.description: Develop all five home-system colonies to Level 2.

achievements.label: Frontier Boomtown
achievements.description: Develop a Kepler Cluster colony to Level 2.

achievements.label: Modest Fortune
achievements.description: Accumulate 10,000 total profit.

achievements.label: Trading Dynasty
achievements.description: Accumulate 100,000 total profit.

achievements.label: Diversified Trader
achievements.description: Sell every good in the home system's economy at least once in a single session.

achievements.label: Market Correction
achievements.description: Crash a good's price below 40% of baseline, then let it recover back above 90%.

achievements.label: Galaxy at Scale
achievements.description: Reach the fully-automated, multi-system endgame state.

achievements.label: A New Beginning
achievements.description: Reach the endgame, then found a new corporation with a permanent legacy bonus.

achievements.label: Guild Partner
achievements.description: Complete a Trade Guild bulk contract.

achievements.label: Guild Favorite
achievements.description: Complete five Trade Guild contracts.

achievements.label: A Thousand Quiet Ledgers
achievements.description: Grow the endgame's background galaxy to its full size.
